shot.camera: static tripod, full-frame cinema camera, 50mm prime, T2.0, shallow depth of field
shot.movement: extremely slow 1% dolly push-in, no shake
shot.focus: microphone razor sharp, mountains softly blurred

scene.location: edge of a mirror-calm alpine lake, first minutes after sunrise
scene.background: huge snow-capped mountains, natural rock formations, atmospheric haze, layered depth
scene.mist: thin morning fog drifting slowly over the water, soft volumetric sunlight through it
scene.water: crystal-clear reflections with tiny natural ripples
scene.details: distant pines barely moving in the wind, tiny dust motes catching the light

subject.object: premium matte-black studio condenser microphone on a small round desk stand, centered slightly below mid-frame
subject.details: brushed metal, fine mesh grille, subtle reflections, tiny imperfections, warm golden sunrise rim light on its right edge

effect.element: very subtle glowing cyan-blue sine waveform floating in front of the microphone
effect.behavior: gently pulsing like a calm voice visualization, soft glow, faint cyan spill on the mic and water, elegant, never dominant, no neon

style: photorealistic real camera footage, luxury tech commercial in the Alps; natural sunrise light, golden highlights, cool blue mountain shadows, natural HDR, soft filmic contrast; premium cinematic grade, slightly desaturated; everything moves almost invisibly, calm and premium
_negative_prompt_field: illustration, 3D render, CGI look, cartoon, low-poly, vector art, neon, excessive bloom, oversaturated colors, flat lighting, text, logo, watermark, UI elements, people, animals, camera shake, fast motion, drone shot
_usage: Coller les sections shot→style (1589 caractères, limite Kling ~2000) dans le champ prompt (mode Professional, 10 s, 16:9) et _negative_prompt_field dans le champ negative. Boucle parfaite : générer d'abord l'image fixe (sans 'effect'), puis image-to-video avec la même image en frame de début et de fin. Pour l'app, préférer la version sans 'effect' et laisser app-background.html dessiner l'onde en direct.
